consumer_warning.title: Scam alert: fake Nairobi Sneaker Vault page
consumer_warning.body:
Fake page alert: @nairobi_sneakervault_official_ke is not Nairobi Sneaker Vault.
Don't send money to 0798 999 111.
Pay only via Buy Goods Till 543210 (NAIROBI SNEAKER VAULT) through @nairobisneakervault.
Please report the fake page and share this message with friends and family.

platform_takedown.body:
I am reporting an account that is impersonating my business, Nairobi Sneaker Vault.

Impersonating account: @nairobi_sneakervault_official_ke (https://instagram.com/nairobi_sneakervault_official_ke)
Our official account(s): @nairobisneakervault (instagram), @nairobisneakervault (tiktok)

Evidence recorded by Halisi (first seen 2026-09-25):
- Profile picture: perceptual-hash distance 4/64 from our registered logo (visual similarity 100%).
- Name/handle similarity to our official account: 100%.
- It asks customers to pay 0798 999 111, which is not registered to our business.
- Uses a logo 100% similar to Nairobi Sneaker Vault's.
- Its name imitates Nairobi Sneaker Vault's official account @nairobisneakervault.
- The payment number on this page has been reported by other customers.
- Asks for payment to a personal number, not Nairobi Sneaker Vault's official payment channel.
- Uses pressure phrases common in scams: 'pay before delivery', 'lipa kwanza', 'send money to', 'offer ends today'.
- The account was created recently (Account is 8 days old · 9 posts · 212 followers).

Please remove this account. It uses our identity to take payments from our customers.
